disclosure.noAccount: It needs no account, and your answer stays on this PC.
disclosure.what: Saying yes sends your games, past and future, to a private pool that Sensei Top's own stats are built from, with everything that names you or your opponent removed first.
disclosure.where: The pool is kept in Brazil, linked to no account, and your games are sent without your sign-in.
disclosure.final: Nothing in a sent game says who sent it. Once it's sent, it can't be shown to you, copied or deleted, not even by deleting your account.
disclosure.stop: You can turn it off at any time in Settings, and nothing more is sent after that.

age.label: I'm 13 or older. If I'm under 18, a parent or guardian has said I can send my games.
age.small: This PC keeps that you confirmed this, and when.

hint.age: To send your games, first confirm your age above.
hint.waitsWelcome: Answer each question above to go to Home.

failure.notSaved: Your answer wasn't saved, and no game is sent. Try again.
failure.stillSending: Your answer wasn't saved, so your games are still being sent. Try again.

page.lead: This version of Sensei Top asks you one new question, once. Until you answer, no game is sent.
page.hintAnswer: Answer the question to go to Home.
page.laterNote: No game is sent. You can answer at any time in Settings, under Help build the stats.

settings.description: Sends your games, without anything that names you or your opponent, to the pool Sensei Top's stats are built from. A sent game can't be deleted.

state.unanswered: Not answered yet, so no game is sent.
state.turnedOn: Turned on. The games you played while it was off are sent too, then each new one.
state.turnedOff: Turned off. No more games are sent from this PC, not even one still waiting to go. Games already sent stay in the pool.

failure.turnOn: Help build the stats wasn't turned on, and no game is sent. Try again.
failure.turnOff: Help build the stats wasn't turned off, so it's still on. Try again.

dialog.title: Send your games to help build the stats?
dialog.hint: To send your games, confirm your age.
